summary: Hempstead County, AR steel lookout on Pinnacle Hill: announced in February 1938 and under construction by March 1938; the only sources are two 1938 Hope Star reports.

events.note: Announced in February 1938; construction reported under way by March 15, 1938; no completion date in the source

evidence.supports: Pinnacle Hill is in Hempstead County; directory lists the Arkansas State Forestry Commission and the site code 14S-25W-35
evidence.quote: Arkansas - Hempstead County - Arkansas State Forestry Commission - 14S-25W-35

evidence.supports: February 1938 announcement of a tower about seven miles due west of Patmos, to be started soon
evidence.quote: The Arkansas State Forestry Commission announces that construction on a forest fire look-out tower will soon be undertaken about seven miles due west of Patmos.

evidence.supports: tower was to check with other towers in the adjoining area
evidence.quote: This tower will be used to check with other towers in the adjoining area.

evidence.supports: March 15, 1938 report: construction undertaken on a new steel tower in Hempstead county, with location code 35-14-24
evidence.quote: March 15, 1938: Construction has been undertaken on a new steel look-out tower in 35-14-24 in Hempstead county.

evidence.supports: tower on Pinnacle Hill, described as an exceedingly high point
evidence.quote: This tower being located on Pinnacle Hill, which is an exceedingly high point.

sources.title: Pinnacle Hill lookout, quoting two 1938 Hope Star reports

notes_for_editor: Single secondary source: a directory page quoting two 1938 Hope Star items. The directory header legal description (14S-25W-35) does not match the location code in the March 15 item (35-14-24); unresolved, and the story says so without choosing. Two WebSearch queries found no other record; hits were unrelated Pinnacle Hill places. The Hope Star originals were not checked. Brief agency matches the header; no correction. No status, height or staffing in any source.
